solutions.title: Height from every root
solutions.strategy: Run BFS from each node as a root and keep nodes with the smallest height.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each possible root runs a graph traversal.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The adjacency list and BFS queue are stored.

solutions.title: Trim leaves
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly remove current leaves until one or two centermost nodes remain.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node and edge is processed as leaves are trimmed.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The adjacency sets and leaf queue are stored.
